answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 53604 Country: India Title: I work in a real estate company to co-ordinate with bank for bank loans. Question: I work in a real estate company as a customer care executive. My job right now is to co-ordinate with the bank and the customers to arrange for bank loans. Is it haram to work in this job? Answer ID: 53604 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1078/1056/N=08/1435) Yes, it is haram. As interest based dealing is haram in the same way it is also haram to help bank and people and to arrange bank loan for them. The holy Quran says: وَلاَ تَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى الإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ [المائدة : 2[ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
